title: aclisia subumbellata
intro: Aclisia subumbellata, commonly known as the Subumbellate Aclisia or Yellow Bells, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, known for its vibrant yellow flowers and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Aclisia subumbellata include its use in treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, that exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Aclisia subumbellata are primarily responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
